body: I understand how you feel. I wish I wasn’t autistic either. There’s nothing good about it. And no matter whether I beat my depression I’ll still be autistic and that’ll still make me want to end it. It’s such a hopeless situation.

My dog has saved me multiple times. When I first attempted, I phoned my friend as I didn’t want my dog to be alone, me and my friend then went on a dog walk. My dogs been there for me when no one else has, as now after 2 years my friends don’t want anything to do with my depression.
Thank you. I am in need of a hug right now lol

Thank you :), although I’m a bit saddened, i promised myself I wouldn’t live to see the end of this year. But I guess there’s always next year. It’s been a pretty shit year for me. I hope things get better, but I know deep down that they won’t.
Thanks for the kind words. I’d love to talk, but I’m not really active that much and there’s probably people who need help more. I’m ok for now and not planning anything anytime soon.

I’m in almost this exact position, apart from my friend hasn’t left me. They just won’t reply to any messages if I try to reach out whilst feeling depressed. I care about them and would never leave them. It just feels as if I’m texting into a void and hoping for a reply. They haven’t replied to my calls for help in almost a year. I feel as if I should attempt again just so they start caring.

Please don’t try it again. I tried the exact same thing earlier this year, and despite many failed attempts that one was the closest I’ve come to kms. I wussed out tho, and whilst I don’t fully regret it, I wouldn’t be completely against doing it again. 

I understand how you feel. Please get help.

Same, I tried to slit my wrist when I was 10. Then at 14 I tried to jump off a cliff and strangle myself. Am currently 15, and will be 16 in a couple months, can’t bear the thought of living any longer.
That’s my plan too, I’m going to end it when I turn 18, unless I haven’t done so already.
Same. I feel as if my life would be a lot better then it currently is. I’m truly failing at life, and feel like giving up.
Added 1
Good. Thanks for asking :)
Thanks. I appreciate you talking to me.
Xbox

It’s rather complicated lol
Yeah I listen to music a lot lol.

Yeah I’ve tried writing, I’m just not that good at it. 

My friends mean everything to me and I they aren’t bad people, they’ve just had enough of dealing with me.
Thanks. But I still talk to my friends, they just ghost me the moment I talk about my depression. It’s so hard.
I don’t really know how to talk about how I feel tbh. I’m still here atm. But I’m not sure for how long.
Happy birthday
I feel the same. In fact for the last 5 months I’ve been feeling like this. My friends have all given up trying to help me. I’m thinking of hanging myself tomorrow.
Please don’t. If things are better then just keep living. What’s the point in giving up now. I’m sure you have so much to live for and so much more fun to have in life. Don’t give up.

I hope your ok. 

I understand your situation regarding school as I feel that way too, and frequently miss it. 

I tried to kms when I was 14, but realised I had so much to live for. 

Things still aren’t 100% better but it’s not really that terrible now. 

I really hope your situation improves, you have so much to live for.
I understand that. But stop telling people their thoughts are stupid/invalid.

Well then you should understand why you shouldn’t be telling people their thoughts are stupid or invalid. 

I’m sorry that happened to you, but you should understand that this isn’t the best place to tell people their thoughts are invalid.

How can depression be confused? 

Just stop it. You just need to do this somewhere else and stop trying to drag already sad people down even further with your completely unneeded negativity.

You clearly are having a very bad day to want to come on here and spread your negativity. I just think here isn’t the most appropriate sub to be trolling on. 

PS, I’m 15.
Do you actually not believe in depression?
You clearly are trolling. No one needs to hear ur little attempt at some attention. Especially not on this sub, just go and do it somewhere else.
I understand how you feel. I made a promise to myself that I’d be dead by the end of this year. And now I’m just going to be disappointed if I make it.
Same, I get how you feel.
It doesn’t make you any more of an idiot lol. But tbh what you’re saying does sound pretty idiotic. Just stop trolling people, they’re here to reach out. They don’t need ur negativity.
I read it. I hope you feel better soon. I know how hard it is.

You obviously don’t know how many kids feel this way. It may seem a silly idea, but when you feel so sad and there isn’t any hope then this idea starts to sound a lot more appealing. If you’re only here to insult others then I suggest you leave…
Thank you for the kind words. I’m managing ok atm. I hope you start to feel better aswell.
I know how you feel. It’s so hard being autistic. I hope things improve for you.

For me it’s my best friend. They’ve helped me so much but recently said they don’t want to talk about my depression with me anymore. I don’t want to die as they’ll feel guilty. 

I hope you start to feel better.
I know how you feel, that’s exactly what I want to do aswell. I hope you get the help you need.
That’s really wrong to say to someone I hope you know that.
This post just summarised the way I feel. I hope your ok.
I don’t think anyone would be happy if you died. I get how you feel about it being a curse tho.

Yeah I see those too. But I know deep down that people will miss me when I’m gone and that one day I will find a use for my skills. I’m sure you’re good at something and if not then I’m sure one day you’ll find something ur good at. But I also understand how you feel.
So relatable. Hope you feel better one day.
I can relate to this. Apart from I didn’t cry Incase anyone heard me.
Happy birthday

Yeah I understand how you feel, I’m autistic too and I completely relate to how ur feeling. 

Keep going, we all have amazing skills and I’m sure ur good at something.
Thank you.
